gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-devanaga: Friendly and loose, Nasalization floats its letters well apart, every stroke the same bold-looking heft from end to end. Anek Devanagari, a plain sans, sits taller and more open.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati reads clean and friendly, its lowercase nearly rivaling the capitals. Nasalization adds rope-thick curves on top, while the plain sans body keeps its gaping c wide and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Round letters bent like wire give Nasalization its unmistakable look, with short ascenders and a big lowercase. And Anek Gurmukhi, a sans with generous open curves, supplies the quiet counterweight that makes the pairing work.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-kannada: Contemporary and crisp, Anek Kannada stands tall on its high x-height. Nasalization's steady-thickness outlines sit above it, and the open-ended sans body gives them room.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin is a sans with tall lowercase that nearly touches the capitals, its curves held open rather than curled shut. Nasalization above it has no hairlines at all, so the heading stays uniformly thick.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-malayala: Anek Malayalam keeps its lowercase almost as tall as the capitals, with curve tips that never quite meet each other. Nasalization's stems and arcs move in lockstep above it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia, a sans with rounds left unlatched like an open hook, keeps its capitals only slightly above the lowercase. Nasalization pours its ink at a single width above it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads modern, with big round bowls and half-unwrapped curves. Nasalization is best at tube-like strokes that hold through every bend, while the sans body does its work in the text.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu sets wide, tall bowls into a reading rhythm of its own, its rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. And Nasalization, cut from one gauge of tubing, gives that sans a heading with a clear, friendly shape.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-anuphan: Nasalization brings flat, contrast-free letterforms with short ascenders and a big lowercase body. Anuphan, a plain sans, offers big round bowls and curves with clear gaps, and that is where the pair's real strength lies.
